queues.note: Single fallback queue by decision. When the organisers' routing matrix arrives, its request-type -> queue mapping replaces this.

needs_time.trigger: borrower says they need time / cannot pay now, without a committed date
needs_time.ask: commit to a payment date and time within the next 2 days
needs_time.rebuttal_style: each rebuttal uses a different, softer reason to commit (date options, amount options, consequences explained factually, help offered); never repeat the same ask; never threaten
needs_time.outside_window: acknowledge and capture any date offered; no rebuttals until next contact day
needs_time.after_rebuttals_exhausted: capture whatever date the borrower gives
needs_time.no_date_after_rebuttals: no hold; K01 stop-for-day applies (response captured); resume next contact day at band caps

promise_to_pay.beyond_auto_accept: capture PTP and hold outreach; open supervisor case to approve or counter
promise_to_pay.hold_rules: see kairos-outreach-policy holds.PROMISE_TO_PAY (check payment on PTP date; unpaid -> BROKEN_PTP, resume next day)

at_or_above_threshold.if_borrower_offers_ptp: inform politely that 2 earlier promises were missed; push for payment now with a payment link
at_or_above_threshold.if_not_paid_now: record PTP in backend with flag NO_HOLD; outreach continues at band caps

callback.trigger: borrower asks to speak to a person
callback.working_hours: K01 contact window on contact days (08:00-19:00, not Sundays/national holidays)
callback.late_request_rule: SLA clock runs only inside working hours; remainder rolls to next contact day
callback.consent: the borrower's explicit request is recorded as consent for this callback only (consent version logged)
callback.dedupe: repeat requests attach to the same open task
callback.if_second_attempt_missed: send one 'we tried to reach you' message with a reply option; resume normal outreach next contact day
callback.if_answered: close task; K01 stop-for-day applies (pickup > 10 s)

hardship.acknowledge: neutral, empathetic acknowledgement; no collection ask in that reply
hardship.hold_rules: see kairos-outreach-policy holds.HARDSHIP (2 days; borrower date within 4 days -> hold until then; beyond 4 days -> supervisor)
hardship.supervisor_visibility: only when borrower's date is beyond 4 days (decided)

routed_exceptions.description: Kairos detects, acknowledges, creates a ticket with a 2-line summary and evidence IDs, and never decides.

WAIVER_REQUEST.conversation: acknowledge, no commitment on waivers or charges

not_handled: deceased / hospitalised borrower (treated as hardship if detected)
wrong number (covered by CM-03 verification gate: no disclosure before OTP)
